resources.string: BMR represents the amount of energy (calories) your body consumes at complete rest, just to maintain vital functions such as breathing, blood circulation, and body temperature.

In addition to BMR, the body expends energy on physical activity, digestion, and other processes. Therefore, total caloric expenditure is generally higher than the BMR. This app estimates values for different goals.
Gain weight: It is estimated to consume 40% more calories than you expend (calorie surplus).
Hypertrophy: It is estimated to consume 20% more calories than you expend, focusing on proteins and strength training.
Lose weight: It is estimated to expend 20% more calories than you consume (calorie deficit).
This app provides an estimate. For personalized plans, consult a nutritionist or medical professional.
